estimand.description: The two-component cosine/sine first harmonic of the response component transverse to the frozen G2,G0 plane.
estimand.stackedModel: y = N eta + a T(phi) + epsilon
estimand.nuisanceProjector: M_N = I - N (N^T W N)^+ N^T W
estimand.identifiability: lambda_min(F)>0; otherwise the transverse effect is indistinguishable from admitted calibration/contact nuisance.
estimand.alternativeDistribution: noncentral chi-square with 2 degrees of freedom and lambda=3n(r a-b_sys)^2/(2 sigma_rel^2)

positivityBudget.exactRequirement: lambda_min(C_h(omega)) >= 0 for every sector and retained frequency
positivityBudget.sufficientPerturbativeBound: For C_h=C_h0+delta C_h, positivity is guaranteed when ||delta C_h||_2 <= lambda_min(C_h0).
positivityBudget.confidenceRequirement: The one-sided lower confidence bound on lambda_min(C_h) must be nonnegative; overlap with zero is inconclusive, not evidence of positivity violation.
positivityBudget.interpretation: The 0.01 synthetic design target lies far inside this sufficient cone margin; this is fixture validation, not a physical prediction.

nuisanceBudget.sectorIndependentContact: Cancels exactly in balanced Z3 cosine/sine contrasts because both harmonic weights sum to zero.
admittedNuisanceColumns: three coordinates of a sector-independent additive contact matrix
frozen-plane estimation directions learned without labelled evaluation data
rules: If r=0, redesign the probes; increasing sample count cannot repair nonidentifiability.
Estimate or bound nuisance columns on training/sham data, never by rotating the plane after labels are revealed.
The measured sham amplitude plus its one-sided uncertainty must remain below 0.001.
If the total bias bound reaches r times the target amplitude, the target is not detectible at any sample count.

frequencyWindow.multiplicityMethod: Bonferroni across the eight preregistered resolution elements
requirements: The window endpoints and resolution bandwidth are frozen from a microscopic prediction or label-blind training data.
Raw bins closer than one response-resolution width count as one resolution element.
At least two resolution elements must pass; oversampling one spectral peak does not satisfy this rule.
The Z3 harmonic phase must be compatible across the passing elements and independent replications.
The same probe, calibration, contact prescription, temperature, geometry and drive apply throughout the window.
Scanning outside the window requires a new protocol or an explicit expanded multiplicity correction.

protocolThresholdCrossingCaution.statement: Power to reject zero at a true amplitude of 0.01 is not 90% power to observe an estimate above the protocol threshold 0.01.

syntheticPowerExample.scope: All numbers are synthetic planning fixtures. They are not estimates of a physical coupling or achievable apparatus noise. The joint-power figure assumes two particular preregistered resolution elements each carry at least the target amplitude; an unspecified effect somewhere in the window has no such guarantee.

uncertaintyAccounting.generalCase: Use the full repeated-run covariance in W and recompute F=T^T W M_N T; the balanced scalar formula is valid only for independent equal-variance sector estimates.
uncertaintyAccounting.normalization: Propagate uncertainty in the mean response norm appearing in A_perp jointly with the numerator, using the delta method or a run-level bootstrap that repeats nuisance fitting.
uncertaintyAccounting.correlatedFrequencies: Use the measured cross-frequency covariance for estimation; count only resolution elements, not raw oversampled bins, for the preregistered multiplicity and two-element rule.
uncertaintyAccounting.nuisanceEstimation: Training or sham uncertainty in nuisance columns and the frozen plane must be propagated, not treated as known exactly.
uncertaintyAccounting.reportedIntervals: Report point estimates and one-sided bounds for positivity margin, A_perp, the third singular value, sham leakage and nuisance retention.

invalid: A response matrix is negative beyond the preregistered one-sided uncertainty allowance.
Probe, calibration, contact, environment or frequency-grid identity differs by sector.
The nuisance-projected signal information has zero minimum eigenvalue.
The frozen window or threshold changes after unblinding.
advance: All validity and positivity requirements pass.
The familywise-corrected Q statistic passes in at least two preregistered resolution elements.
The point estimate A_perp exceeds 0.01 in those elements.
A conservative lower confidence bound exceeds the measured sham/systematic floor.
The nuisance-projected third singular direction has a positive one-sided lower confidence bound.
The phase-compatible result repeats in two independent replications and survives reversed order.
Common-calibration rank/relative invariants agree with the fixed-coordinate statistic.
poweredNull: The planned sample size and achieved noise certify at least 90% joint power over the declared effect window.
In each of two independent implementations, fewer than two predicted resolution elements have a conservative upper bound reaching 0.01.
All validity controls pass, so absence is not caused by positivity, drift or identifiability failure.
decisionThresholds.inconclusive: Any valid outcome that meets neither the advance rule nor the powered-null rule.
decisionThresholds.physicalMeaning: Advance moves A11 to an empirical anomaly requiring microscopic explanation; it does not establish Spin(2,3). Powered null rejects the declared effect window, not unspecified future couplings.
